title: chat-server: ChatBackend has no delegation; add a delegating wrapper or macro for wrapping MemoryBackend
description: chat-server: ChatBackend has no delegation; add a delegating wrapper or macro for wrapping MemoryBackend. Source: mimid session request 2026-11-19 (mimid-s2qc for embedding items).
notes: 2026-11-19: deferred for Mark's decision. ChatBackend has ~43 methods plus JmapBackend's 12, and MemoryBackend overrides many defaults, so a wrapper must forward nearly all to keep reference behaviour. Options: (a) a macro_rules delegate_chat_backend! that forwards every method to a field, with overrides written as a separate trait impl is not possible in Rust, so the macro would need an exclusion list; (b) split ChatBackend into smaller hook traits; (c) leave as is. Each adds maintenance in step with the trait.
